applicabilityBasis.summary: sfrxUSD is a yield-accruing ERC-4626-like savings-vault share whose frxUSD value per share increases with strategy returns. Share redemption delivers a variable amount of frxUSD rather than a fixed national-currency payment claim.

genius.notes: Assess the savings share separately from frxUSD. The issuer documentation describes Treasury/carry/AMO strategies and increasing asset-per-share value. FIP-430 also describes possible strategy-loss constraints, so public fully-redeemable marketing is not treated as an unconditional guaranteed fiat redemption right. Parent frxUSD charter intent does not authorize sfrxUSD.
